summary: Table-sized rock flake broke loose on pitch 1 of a Red Garden Wall climb: the lead climber fell, suffered a lacerated liver, and walked out; the belayer was struck and suffered incapacitating injuries (fractured femur, hip, tibia, fibula, foot); multi-agency high-angle rescue with scree evacuation and a Tyrolean highline across South Boulder Creek; Air Life helicopter.
location: Red Garden Wall, Eldorado Canyon State Park
responding_agency: BCSO, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Rocky Mountain Fire Authority, Boulder Emergency Squad, Colorado State Parks
notes: Date pinned via AAC Accidents in North American Climbing 2021 "Rockfall Onto Belayer" account covering the 2020 season
